protocol: Three new training seeds; identical outer and inner shot partitions and cv2 hyperparameters. Thresholds and best epochs are selected separately on each fixed inner-validation split.
ci_method: 95% percentile shot bootstrap, 1000 replicates per run; seed spread is reported separately and is not a CI.

training_code.evidence: The run recorded base HEAD 21183f0 while the producing training implementation was in the working tree; that implementation was subsequently committed as 0d16c19. Saved fold records and artifact times are consistent with this history. No contemporaneous working-tree snapshot survives, so this is a retrospective reconstruction.
